messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Deepa,

Attached separately is the agreed-form mutual NDA for Project Tamarisk for signature by Northstar. Five-year term, mutual, subject-to-contract carve-outs as discussed. Once your client has signed we'll arrange Halverson's signature and circulate the fully executed version.

Thanks

Best,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
